gloss: a little while ago; just now

definitions.gloss: a little while ago; just now
definitions.explanation: Refers to a short time before the present moment.

examples.japanese: さっき⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: There was a phone call just now.

examples.japanese: さっき⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦でしょう→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧。
examples.english: I told you just a moment ago, didn't I?

examples.japanese: さっき⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧。
examples.english: He was here until just a moment ago.

notes:
さっき is an adverb meaning "a little while ago" or "just now," referring to the very recent past (usually minutes to an hour ago).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- さっき〜した: did ~ just now
- さっきまで: until just now
- さっきから: since a little while ago
- さっきの: the one from just now

TIME REFERENCE WORDS:
- さっき: a few minutes ago (very recent)
- このあいだ: the other day (days to weeks)
- {前|まえ}に: before (general past)
- {最近|さいきん}: recently (days to weeks)
- {先|さき}ほど: a little while ago (more formal than さっき)

NOTE:
さっき is casual. In formal situations, use {先|さき}ほど instead.
